title: Thymus vulgaris essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Thymus vulgaris essential oil is a concentrated aromatic compound derived from the flowering plant Thymus vulgaris, commonly known as thyme. It is widely used in herbalism for its potent antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. This essential oil is often employed to support respiratory health by helping to relieve congestion and soothe coughs. It can also be used topically to treat skin infections and promote wound healing. In aromatherapy, it is valued for its ability to uplift mood and reduce stress.
